cmd: echo '=== main log: first/last lines ===' && head -3 /var/log/vps-pipeline.log && echo ... && tail -3 /var/log/vps-pipeline.log && echo '=== is there logrotate for these? ===' && ls -la /etc/logrotate.d/ 2>&1 | grep -i weather && echo '=== push-failed events per day (main) ===' && grep -oP '^\S+ \S+' /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | head -1 && grep -B20 'push failed after 3 attempts' /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | grep -oE '^[A-Za-z]{3} [0-9]{1,2}' | sort | uniq -c || true && echo '=== try timestamps directly around failures (main), sample 3 ===' && grep -n 'push failed after 3 attempts' /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | head -3 | cut -d: -f1 | while read ln; do sed -n "$((ln>15?ln-15:1)),${ln}p" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | grep -E '^(Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun)|^[0-9]{4}-|cycle|====' ; echo '---'; done
